<description>
**Problem:** When `decodepsbt` writes partial signatures to JSON, it scans the keys it has already added for every signature.
The parser stores signatures by public key ID, so the same public key cannot appear twice in an input's signature map.

**Fix:** Append the entries directly with `pushKVEnd` to skip the repeated scans.
</description>

<commits>
f01e4c207b test: check decoded PSBT partial signatures

Check that `decodepsbt` reports exactly the public keys and signatures in the existing PSBT combiner test vectors.

5ef0b448c9 rpc: skip key lookups for decodepsbt partial signatures

The PSBT parser stores each partial signature by the ID of its public key, so the hex-encoded public keys are already distinct.
Use `pushKVEnd` to append each entry without scanning the keys already added.
</commits>
